title: Page designer: the add-block palette does not offer list-view, though the block now has an inspector panel
body:
## Source

Found by the #26703 card thread (PR #26793, open question), checked by the ui seat on `origin/main` `4f05de4b`.

## Problem

PR #26793 gives the page `list-view` block a `BLOCK_CONFIG` panel (Object, View, Row limit). The add-block palette still does not offer the block: `TYPES_BY_CATEGORY` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-types.ts` is built from `BLOCK_TYPE_META`, and `BLOCK_TYPE_META` has no `list-view` row. A designer can edit a list block a page already carries (published pages place it, for example `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-4.0.1-published-pages.artifact.json`), but cannot add one from the palette. PR #26793 records this with a one-row `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE` exemption in `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts`, which goes red once the palette offers the block.

## Target

Offer `list-view` in the palette: add it to `BlockTypeId` and `BLOCK_TYPE_META` (category `data`, icon, a type label key in `../i18n.ts` en + zh), and drop its `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE` row. Check the canvas default for a new block, so a freshly added list block either asks for its object or carries an empty `dataSource` the panel fills.

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-types.ts`, the metadata-admin `i18n.ts` type label keys, `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` (remove the exemption row), tests beside, one changeset. No `packages/spec/**` change: `list-view` already has a `ComponentPropsMap` entry and a public-block renderer.

## Acceptance

A test: the page palette lists `list-view` under its category, and adding it then selecting it opens the Object / View / Row limit panel. The `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE` table is empty or gone.

Related: #26703, PR #26793.
